title: MPOLYGON fill-color callback publication fast slice
objective: Extend the existing DXF MPOLYGON group-430 retained-string owner control through full-read callback suppression and same-facade retry for ASCII and Binary DXF.

implementation.generatedInput: Locally authored AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF in an isolated temporary directory; each has a closed three-vertex MPOLYGON boundary, a 512-byte group-430 fill-color name, a LINE sentinel with distinct coordinates, and EOF.
assertions: Discover the minimum successful full-read retained-byte budget by binary search.
At exact cap, capture addMPolygon then addLine with the exact fill-color string and expected LINE handle/coordinates.
At cap minus one, require ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget before either entity callback.
Raise the same facade to the measured exact cap and require a successful same-facade retry with ordered callbacks.
scopeLimits: Does not change production parsing or retained-byte ownership.
Does not establish HATCH semantics, writer/projection-copy memory, public post-callback caller mutation bounds, DWG storage, native acceptance, or format support.
No persistent external drawing or new CTest was added.

workingTree.reason: The shared checkout already contains broad user changes. This slice remains local and uncommitted; unrelated changes were not staged or altered.
